quote: The model must distinguish permission to approve, permission to start spending, and permission to accept.
requirement: The system must keep approval, spending start, and acceptance as distinct authorities.
pack_quote: Gate 1 and the batch start are in the mandate; the Owner is asked only when they are not.

quote: Accepting a parent must not admit a held child.
requirement: Accepting a parent folder must never admit a held or sensitive child.
pack_quote: records excluded subtree and read barrier
note: The exclusion barrier is preserved, though the source's broader held-child rule is not spelled out at that node.

quote: A model-unavailable or unapproved draft remains queued/partial; folder enrichment does not claim content examination.
requirement: Unavailable or unapproved folder drafting must remain visibly queued or partial and never claim content examination.
pack_quote: drafts inventory-grounded folder summary without reading documents
note: The no-reading constraint is preserved; explicit queued/partial handling is less complete.

quote: Delegated repair does not grant write access to originals.
requirement: Delegated repair must not grant write access to attached originals.
note: Rule added 26 November: a remedy never writes an attached original; originals are read-only to every agent.

quote: A comprehensive cycle needs this branch; the paper-only example does not cover it.
requirement: The enrichment cycle must branch by folder purpose before creating Sources.
pack_quote: Source-eligible inputs present
note: Source eligibility is carried, but the full third-party, research-docs, own-docs and own-code/data/logs branch is only implicit.

quote: Compare survey scope with queue scope, ledger and per-root ownership; a zero top-root count does not prove an empty corpus.
requirement: Queueing must use accepted-root ownership and reconcile survey, queue, ledger, and omission counts.
pack_quote: reconciles one paged ledger for the folder, and separates the folder, source, lens, topic and bridge lists
note: The ledger carries reconciliation, but per-root ownership and the zero-count warning are not explicit.

quote: Neutral source description and complete reading are different operations.
requirement: Capture provenance and neutral description must remain separate from complete reading.
pack_quote: proposes a readable title when the header is a slug or file name, a neutral description, its fields (Unknown where unsupported) and topics
note: Neutral description is preserved and reading remains a separate source-reading process.

quote: Tier-0 task context must not contaminate neutral readings.
requirement: Task fit and project framing must not contaminate neutral source evidence or reading.
pack_quote: carries out bounded reading and synthesis tasks within the reserved budget
note: The pack keeps neutral intake and bounded reading separate, but does not explicitly forbid task-context contamination.

quote: Reconcile counts as captured, duplicate, screened out, failed, held or queued rather than assuming every surveyed item becomes a new Source.
requirement: Deduplication must preserve provenance and account for every surveyed item's outcome.
pack_quote: reconciles one paged ledger for the folder, and separates the folder, source, lens, topic and bridge lists
note: Accounting is preserved, but the exact captured, duplicate, screened-out, failed, held, and queued categories are not enumerated.

quote: Model an authorized start rather than treating approval as execution.
requirement: Approval must not start processing; an authorized explicit start must freeze the exact batch.
pack_quote: checks the Lead's approval against the grant and the run's checkpoint, and freezes the mixed batch
note: The essential approval/start distinction and frozen batch are carried.

quote: Before conversion/read; new completeness model must include this stage.
requirement: Source evidence and duplicate validation must precede conversion and reading.
pack_quote: verifies the evidence hash, the route and recipe, and that publication state is current
note: Validation precedes parse, but duplicate-state validation is not explicit at this node.

quote: Choosing a fallback must preserve its limitations and original file.
requirement: Parsing must retain locators, original files, and explicit fallback limitations.
pack_quote: restores original extracted text and keeps conversion gap explicit
note: Original text and gaps are preserved; page locators are carried by the conversion nodes rather than this fallback node.

quote: A partial OCR must not become full-conversion evidence or be silently substituted with another model.
requirement: Partial OCR must remain partial and must never be silently substituted or treated as full conversion.
pack_quote: stores the conversion with its authorship, and reconciles the spend
note: Conversion authorship and gaps are preserved, but the explicit no-substitution rule is missing.

quote: required extraction tasks must answer before a part counts as read
requirement: A source part counts as read only when its required extraction tasks answer.
pack_quote: verifies each part's schema and quotes, and keeps part reading apart from the whole-source pass
note: Part verification is carried, though the exact required-task completion condition is not stated.

quote: A generated lens is not automatically an accepted reasoning instruction. It is a distinct output of the enrichment cycle.
requirement: Lens proposals must remain separate from lens acceptance.
pack_quote: stores the grounded lens candidates, read blind; accepting them is a separate decision
note: The essential separation is explicitly preserved.

quote: To-be model must retain kind branches and outputs; not every source is a paper or requires chapters.
requirement: Data and Information records must retain kind-specific derivations and legitimate inapplicability.
pack_quote: extracts the structural Data records and the static code relations by script, at no cost
note: Kind-specific extraction is carried, but explicit unsupported-kind and empty-record outcomes are missing.

quote: Do not equate this with completed cross-corpus relation scoring/trust.
requirement: Relations may use only grounded, fully read components and must not imply broader relation trust.
pack_quote: proposes semantic chapter relations across read chapters (Core persists)
note: Read-grounded chapter relations are preserved; the explicit warning against inferring cross-corpus trust is absent.

quote: Preserve source-specific metadata and later confirmation.
requirement: Metadata proposals must not falsify reading status and must retain unknown fields for later confirmation.
pack_quote: proposes semantic content-model metadata fields from evidence; retains Unknown where insufficient
note: Unknowns and evidence-grounded proposals are preserved; later confirmation is not explicit.

quote: Neither this stage nor the model's confidence is the general independent Oracle.
requirement: Bottom Line drafting must remain distinct from claim review and independent Oracle judgment.
pack_quote: reviews what Tier A cannot decide: claims against passages, neutrality, whether the question is answered
note: The Oracle is distinct, but the pack does not explicitly state that source review confidence is not an Oracle verdict.

quote: Graph success is conditional on modality and verified conversion; catalogue-only is not silently promoted to full-text graph success.
requirement: Paper publication must follow verified full reading and conversion and never promote catalogue-only output to full success.
pack_quote: eligible for Geo paper publication?

quote: Preserve through pipeline conversion; no second run store, SQLite owner or hidden direct write path.
requirement: All mutable library state must remain behind Core ownership with no second state owner.
pack_quote: stores the sprint's specification in the Core, checks the order action, workflow, pipeline, sprint has no cycle, and compiles the manifest and the permission envelope
note: Core storage is preserved, but the prohibition on a second run store or hidden write path is not explicit.

quote: A retry/remedy must state which receipt remains valid; counts alone cannot justify reuse.
requirement: Only exact matching completion receipts may be reused across retries or remedies.
pack_quote: binds the source and its workflow's mandate (never wider than the parent), and the receipts of work already done
note: Receipt reuse is carried, but exact key matching and invalidation rules are not specified.

quote: Do not mark a run successful simply because its worker stopped.
requirement: Cancellation, failure, waiting, partial completion, and inapplicability must remain distinct outcomes.
pack_quote: returns the non-critical partial source, with its unmet tasks and any quarantine stated
note: Partial and paused outcomes are preserved, though the full status taxonomy is not carried explicitly.

quote: Do not claim an exact per-call monetary cap from a between-item ceiling check.
requirement: Budget evidence must be honest and must not claim a per-call cap from a between-item ceiling check.
pack_quote: checks cancellation and the lease, and reserves the budget before dispatching
note: Budget reservation is preserved, but the explicit prohibition on claiming a per-call cap is missing.

quote: To-be 16a retains person-mode notification.
requirement: The responsible party must be told when enriched reading awaits acceptance.
pack_quote: receives the verified result: the catalogued notes, the spend and the deferred work
note: Owner notification is carried, but the specific awaiting-acceptance signal is not explicit.

quote: Permitted delegation must preserve the person's reserved decisions and truthful attestation.
requirement: Acceptance must follow mode and sensitivity rules and record the true deciding actor.
pack_quote: accepts the in-scope sources and folder cards, recorded as accepted by an agent with their flags kept; defers the reserved ones
note: Agent attestation and reserved decisions are explicitly preserved.

quote: The Oracle must judge the stated guarantee; partial acceptance is not a claim of full reading/full graph publication.
requirement: Accepted partial sources must retain truthful coverage and must not imply full reading or publication.
pack_quote: stores the partial coverage, spend, deferred items and open tickets
note: Partial coverage is preserved, but the explicit prohibition on implying full guarantees is absent.

quote: Promotion/retry must preserve human edits and retained originals, not blindly repeat writes.
requirement: Promotion must fingerprint and guard writes while preserving human edits and retained originals.
pack_quote: checks the staged revision, writes the Source note through the guarded writer and indexes it
note: Guarded writes are preserved; preservation of human edits and originals is not explicit at this node.

quote: Written, accepted and catalogued/findable are separate outcomes.
requirement: Writing, acceptance, and catalogued findability must remain separate reported outcomes.
pack_quote: verifies findability, neutrality and the ledger on a route distinct from the workers'
note: Findability is independently checked, but the three outcomes are not explicitly separated in one node.

quote: The enrichment cycle can revisit accepted knowledge without silently replacing the person's edits.
requirement: Later reading of an accepted note must stage a revision rather than overwrite the accepted note.
note: Added 26 November: the accepted-note entity; a later reading stages a revision and never overwrites the note.

quote: tier 0 is the Overseer and may delegate through Librarian on the owner's behalf; tier 1 is Lead, tier 2 Clerk, tier 3 Scribe
requirement: Tier 0 is the Overseer and may delegate Librarian work on the owner's behalf, with Lead, Clerk and Scribe as tiers 1-3.
pack_quote: The Owner said tier 0 should have the authority to act on the Owner's behalf, so routine permission gates must not interrupt it.
note: The authority table carries tier 0 acting for the Owner and the named tiers; the exact role-tier mapping is only implicit.

quote: Specifications are Core-owned. The fault register is a ticket service with tiered flags and responsible actors.
requirement: Specifications are owned by the Core, and faults are tracked as tickets with tiered flags and responsible actors.
pack_quote: The fault register is a ticket service: each ticket class has one owner, a queue, and a named recipient of its handover.
note: Ticket routing is carried explicitly; Core ownership of specifications is only implicit in the Core storing specifications.

quote: GLM-5.3 is the current, revisable assignment for both oracle and doctor. These choices update the design
requirement: GLM-5.3 is the current but revisable model assignment for both the Oracle and the Doctor.
pack_quote: OPEN QUESTION UC-O Judge a process's output: Which model is assigned to the Oracle (revisable)
note: Model assignment is revisable and not part of the design; the README records that GLM-5.3 was named on 24 November.

quote: Deterministic **validators** per diagram kind, which refuse a malformed spec instead of repairing it.
requirement: Each diagram kind has deterministic validators that refuse a malformed spec rather than repair it.
note: The pack renderer reports a malformed spec as an error and never repairs it.

quote: every diagram run records a short *problem statement* first: the symptom observed, the "why?" chain, and the root cause where it is known
requirement: Every diagram run records a problem statement with the symptom, the why chain and the root cause before modelling.
note: Parent specs carry problem statements; requiring one in every spec is diagram tooling, deferred in the README.

quote: What is inside is the Librarian's to change. What is outside (the model host, Geo-Grapher's internals, the Owner's own judgement) is drawn as an actor
requirement: A use case boundary records what the Librarian may change and draws external systems and the Owner's judgement only as actors.
note: G1 draws the Owner and outside systems as actors outside the system boundary.

quote: A mismatch is reported as a flag, not fixed silently.
requirement: Cross-view inconsistencies are reported as flags and never repaired silently.
note: Cross-view checks (render_spec.cross_check) are reported as errors, never repaired.

quote: a diagram names the role, never the model; the model appears only in provenance
requirement: Diagrams name roles rather than models, recording the assigned model only in provenance.
note: Lanes must be terminology roles; model names were removed from labels (tools/s4_plain_language.py).

quote: Specifications belong within the Librarian Core, which owns their storage and the revision used by a run.
requirement: Diagram specifications are stored in the Librarian Core, which owns the revision each run uses.
note: The to-be stores specifications in the Core; these packs are review artifacts, as docs/terminology.md says.

quote: An unknown node kind is refused, never guessed.
requirement: A diagram validator refuses an unknown node kind instead of guessing it.
note: validate() refuses an unknown node kind.

quote: Accepting a pack is a person's decision (`lens_pack_accept`), as now. The lens a diagram ran under is recorded in its `provenance`
requirement: A lens pack is accepted only by a person, and each diagram records the lenses it ran under.
note: Lens-pack acceptance and lens provenance are diagram tooling, deferred in the README.

quote: Repair is bounded to two attempts; after that the spec waits for a person. Nothing is repaired silently.
requirement: Spec repair is limited to two attempts and then waits for a person, with no silent repair.
note: The digest carries bounded retries for reviews and repairs, but no two-attempt bound for diagram spec repair.

quote: The Owner approves, and the Core writes the canvas through the safe, hash-checked commit (W2). Afterwards a person's moves on the canvas are kept
requirement: A rendered canvas is written only after Owner approval through a hash-checked commit, preserving a person's node moves.
note: Canvas approval is diagram tooling (D1 stopped swim-lane canvases); the index canvases are wholly generated.

quote: Generated ids must start with `librarian-`; every other node is treated as the owner's and kept.
requirement: Generated canvas node ids start with librarian-, and every other node is treated as the Owner's and kept.
note: The W2 canvas service enforces the librarian- prefix and keeps every other node; render_pack writes index canvases through it.

quote: A canvas holding no `librarian-` node is never merged into without `adopt=True`.
requirement: A canvas with no librarian- node is never merged into unless explicitly adopted.
note: The canvas service refuses to merge into a canvas with no librarian- node unless adopted.

quote: The Oracle | Judges a run's output against its specification | Executes or repairs anything; it is read-only
requirement: The Oracle judges a run's output against its specification and never executes or repairs anything.
pack_quote: Every parent process ends its run with the Oracle's verdict, which is itself a checked claim.
note: Judging output against a specification is carried; the explicit read-only prohibition is not stated in the digest.

quote: The Doctor | Repairs a failure the oracle tagged, by a catalogued remedy within its blast radius | Judges completion
requirement: The Doctor repairs only Oracle-tagged failures with a catalogued remedy inside its blast radius and never judges completion.
pack_quote: only accepted remedies within a computed blast radius and the Doctor's limits, routing that never blocks the caller
note: Bounded accepted remedies are carried; the digest does not explicitly require the Oracle to tag the failure first.

quote: they share no conversation with the worker or with each other; each sees only what its role is given
requirement: Oracle, Doctor and workers share no conversation and each sees only the material its role is given.
note: The packs require distinct Oracle routes but never state the no-shared-context rule.

quote: it can be **rebutted**: the worker answers with evidence, and a person decides, as with a challenged claim in UC3
requirement: An Oracle verdict is a rebuttable claim: the worker may answer with evidence and a person decides.
pack_quote: Keeping a challenged claim with a rebuttal, reserved, the Owner decides
note: The reserved person decision over a rebutted claim is carried; the general rule that every verdict is rebuttable is not.

quote: it is **checked itself**: `closure_audit.py` already re-checks each closure by an independent route, and counts a failed re-check as a *false closure*
requirement: Oracle verdicts are themselves re-checked by an independent route, and failed re-checks are counted as false closures.
pack_quote: re-checks that the verdict's evidence exists and still holds
note: Independent re-checking of the verdict is carried; counting false closures is not.

quote: Critical: security, data loss, a boundary crossed, a person's decision | **Tier 0 and the Owner**, at once
requirement: A critical security, data-loss, boundary or person-decision finding goes immediately to tier 0 and the Owner.
pack_quote: Critical: security, data loss, a boundary crossed, a critical flag, Overseer (tier 0) and the Owner, at once
note: The critical routing is carried exactly; the source additionally includes a person's decision in the critical class.

quote: Every oracle has **exactly one specification owner**. Either: **tier 0 sets it for a tier-1 run**
requirement: Every Oracle run has exactly one specification owner, set by tier 0 or by a delegating Lead, never both.
note: The digest records specification owners for sprints but has no one-owner-per-Oracle-run or set_by rule.

quote: A tier-1 spec may only **narrow** a tier-0 parent's spec, never widen it.
requirement: A tier-1 specification may narrow its tier-0 parent's specification but never widen it.
pack_quote: does the sub-run's manifest stay within its parent's mandate, reserved decisions included?
note: Sub-runs must stay within the parent mandate is carried; the digest does not state the narrowing-only rule for specifications.

quote: For a delegated run it sets the spec and terminal fallback (escalate, keep what passed, or abort), then receives one terminal notification.
requirement: For a delegated run tier 0 sets the specification and terminal fallback and receives exactly one terminal notification.
pack_quote: tier 0 commissions once and receives one handover: two tier-0 turns on the main path (ideal)
note: One handover to tier 0 is carried; the named terminal fallback choices are not.

quote: Permissions and budgets remain explicit; reducing tier-0 turns never removes an ingestion requirement or a reserved decision.
requirement: Reducing tier-0 turns must never remove an ingestion requirement or a reserved person decision.
pack_quote: A **reserved decision** is the person's by policy. It is never a permission prompt: it goes on the agenda with its owner and evidence
note: Reserved decisions remain the person's and non-blocking is carried; the explicit protection of ingestion requirements is not.

quote: Deterministic first: tests, AST checks, schema validators.
requirement: Change checks run deterministic tests and validators before model assessment.
note: Deterministic Tier A checks run before any Tier B model review.

quote: A worker's success assertion cannot close a ticket in place of the oracle's re-check.
requirement: A worker's success assertion never closes a ticket; only the Oracle's re-check can.
pack_quote: A worker never closes its own ticket: the Oracle's recheck closes it (`doctor:oracle`).
note: The rule is carried exactly.

quote: A declared compensation is shown for a person to decide, as composition policy requires; the ticket service does not automatically run an undo.
requirement: Compensation is shown for a person to decide and is never automatically run as an undo.
pack_quote: A compensation is shown, never run by the runner (composition rule 8).
note: The no-automatic-compensation rule is carried; the digest does not explicitly say a person decides whether to undo.

quote: Trying several candidate remedies needs either an isolated dry run, or a verified compensation step behind the scope check
requirement: Trying multiple remedies requires an isolated dry run or a verified compensation step behind the scope check.
note: The to-be runs one accepted remedy per ticket (a single repair attempt), so trying several remedies is not permitted at all.

quote: A process is built from processes that come earlier in the order, and the process built is their **parent process**
requirement: A process is built only from processes earlier in the action-to-sprint order, and the result is their parent process.
pack_quote: a workflow holds actions and, without a cycle, workflows; a pipeline holds workflows and actions; a sprint holds pipelines, workflows and actions
note: The layer rule is carried; the digest does not use the term parent process for the built process.

quote: A record of acceptance says who actually accepted: the person, or the agent acting under the library's agent promotion mode.
requirement: Acceptance records must name the actual accepting person or agent, never misattribute an agent's acceptance to a person.
pack_quote: Owner decision: whether to correct the attester on the 96 notes accepted on 20 November.
note: The rule is in acceptance:leadaccept; correcting the 96 historical notes is the Owner's open decision (W-ACC-04).

quote: A review that shares the worker's context repeats the worker's assumptions; a meta-reasoning loop told to "look at your work and correct it" produced "corrections" that were themselves wrong.
requirement: Review must be kept apart from the work, with the oracle and doctor sharing no context or assignment with the worker.
pack_quote: droute [decision; Core]: is the Oracle's route distinct from every worker's in this run?
note: The distinct-route requirement is carried throughout the to-be packs; the same-model assignment reconciliation remains an open policy caveat.

quote: A verdict is a claim, not an order. It carries its evidence, can be rebutted with evidence (a person decides), and is itself re-checked.
requirement: A review verdict must be an evidenced, re-checkable claim, and a person decides any rebuttal.
pack_quote: verdict [activity; Oracle]: records its verdict as a claim, with its evidence
note: Re-checking is carried by oracle:recheck; the person-decides rebuttal is carried as a reserved decision in the authority table.

quote: A sub-run may only narrow its parent's specification, never widen it.
requirement: A sub-run must never widen its parent's specification or mandate.
pack_quote: dnarrow [decision; Core]: does the sub-run's manifest stay within its parent's mandate, reserved decisions included?
note: The constraint is carried in compose:dnarrow and ingestion:admit_mandate; wider scope requires an Owner decision.

quote: Promotion-mode changes, lead-override checkpoints, sensitivity reviews and spending without approval stay with the person, whichever agent asks.
requirement: Reserved decisions remain with the person regardless of which agent asks.
pack_quote: A reserved decision is the person's by policy. It is never a permission prompt: it goes on the agenda with its owner and evidence
note: The authority table carries the reserved decisions; delegating one to tier 0 is explicitly still an Owner decision.

quote: The fault register is a ticket service. A ticket carries the existing failure or extension, its evidence, the tiered flags that apply, and who must address it.
requirement: Failures must be tracked as tickets with evidence, flags, owner and repair history rather than a fixed four-bit mask.
pack_quote: One tracked failure, from its extension point to a checked repair or a recorded decision.
note: The ticket entity and ticket-routing table carry the model; the general ticket service is proposed, not implemented.

quote: Specifications belong within the Librarian Core. The Core owns their storage and the specification used by a run.
requirement: Specifications must be stored and owned by the Librarian Core, not by reports or canvases.
pack_quote: compile_manifest [activity; Core]: stores the sprint's specification in the Core, checks the order action, workflow, pipeline, sprint has no cycle
note: Core storage is carried in compose and catalogue; the physical backend and run integration remain open implementation work.

quote: Each agent finishes the work it is given. No agent may leave its own steps for another tier to complete.
requirement: Each agent must finish its assigned work or state plainly what is left and why.
note: Each handover states the deferred work and tickets left; policy line 58.

quote: A model is assigned to a role (Lead, Scribe, Clerk, research helper, OCR…). An assignment is always revisable.
requirement: Model assignments to roles must be revisable and never treated as permanent.
note: The README records assignments as revisable and outside the design; docs/terminology.md says assign, never bind.

quote: A process is built only from processes earlier in the order, or of its own kind without a cycle.
requirement: Processes may compose only from earlier process kinds or their own kind without a cycle.
pack_quote: a5 [activity; Core]: validates the layer rule: an action has no components; a workflow holds actions and, without a cycle, workflows
note: The layer rule is carried in catalogue:a5; the digest's open question notes a conflict over same-layer components outside workflows.

quote: Only registered actions do anything. A process holds no code between steps and cannot run shell text.
requirement: Only registered actions may perform work; processes must contain no code or shell between steps.
pack_quote: worker_roles [activity; Clerk (tier 2)]: carries out the assigned interpretation, review and bounded reading and writing over the Core's scripted actions
note: The to-be routes all work through Core scripted actions and the registry, but no node states the no-shell-text prohibition explicitly.

quote: A process is validated before it is saved, and pinned when it runs. A run executes the exact text it started with
requirement: A process must be validated before saving and pinned to its exact definition when run.
pack_quote: a8 [activity; Core]: runs the process for the task, pinned to its digest
note: Catalogue:a4 validates and a8 pins by digest; regeneration on definition change is carried in the manifest rule.

quote: A step's labels never understate it. A step's side-effect class is derived from its action.
requirement: A step's declared side-effect class must never understate its action's actual effects.
note: Added 26 November: validation refuses a step declaring less than its action's registered effects.

quote: A compensation is shown, never run by the runner. A person decides whether to undo a step after a failure.
requirement: Compensation must be displayed but never automatically run; a person decides any undo.
pack_quote: showcomp [activity; Core]: attaches the compensation plan and the failed attempt to the ticket; it is shown, never run automatically
note: Doctor:showcomp carries the rule; the ticket-routing table repeats that compensation is shown, never run by the runner.

quote: A component must fit its parent's mandate. A parent process states the highest tier, the effects and the outside access it allows
requirement: Every component must fit within its parent's stated mandate of tier, effects and outside access.
pack_quote: d5 [decision; Core]: does the manifest fit the parent's mandate: tier, effects, outside access and deny list?
note: Catalogue:d5 and compose:dnarrow carry the fit check; the deny list is included in the manifest decision.

quote: The fit is judged from the manifest, not by reading the component. A manifest is compiled from the process's definition and the registry
requirement: Mandate fit must be judged from a compiled manifest, never by hand-reading the component.
pack_quote: a6 [activity; Core]: compiles the manifest: the component tree, the actions in order, their declared effects, tier and outside access, and the blast radius
note: Manifest compilation is carried in catalogue:a6 and compose:compile_manifest; hand-editing is excluded by the policy text but not restated in a node.

quote: A process joins the repertoire only by promotion. It is validated, accepted by the Owner, and its digest pinned
requirement: A process enters the repertoire only through validation, Owner acceptance and a pinned digest.
pack_quote: a11 [activity; Owner]: accepts the process into the repertoire
note: Catalogue:a10-a12 carry duplicate checking, Owner acceptance and digest pinning; an agent may propose but not promote.

quote: Before drafting a process, look for an accepted one that covers the need, lowest layer first.
requirement: Composition must start from accepted repertoire processes, preferring the lowest layer.
pack_quote: a2 [activity; Core]: searches the repertoire, the Core's store of accepted processes, for one that covers it, lowest layer first
note: Carried verbatim in catalogue:a2; a duplicate draft is refused in favour of the accepted process.

quote: A role is limited by its mount, not by a list of prohibitions. A role sees, and composes from, only its subset of the repertoire
requirement: A role's authority must be limited by its repertoire mount, not by prose prohibition lists.
note: Added 26 November: a worker sees only the repertoire mounted for its role.

quote: A run's permission is asked once, for what its manifest predicts (owner, 21 November 2026).
requirement: A run's permissions must be approved once as an envelope predicted by its manifest.
pack_quote: commission [activity; Overseer (tier 0)]: writes the sprint's specification on the Owner's behalf and approves its permission envelope once, with no second ask
note: The once-only envelope is carried in activation-overseer:commission and compose; per-call always-ask tools are excluded by policy but not drawn as a node.

quote: An envelope never holds what a person reserves, nor a per-call always-ask tool, nor anything above the parent's mandate.
requirement: A permission envelope must exclude reserved decisions, always-ask tools and anything above the parent mandate.
pack_quote: A permission is granted once, by the commission or the person's own start, and is never asked again inside the run.
note: The authority table carries reserved exclusions; the always-ask and above-mandate exclusions appear only in policy text, so the node-level carry is partial.

quote: A call outside the envelope is judged before it is asked. The oracle decides whether it is in scope of the run's specification
requirement: An out-of-envelope call must be judged in scope by the Oracle before any permission request.
pack_quote: oracle_scope [activity; Oracle]: judges an ungranted call against the sprint's specification before anyone is asked
note: Carried in compose:oracle_scope; allowances are logged and reported at the end of the run.

quote: Code checks what code can check. A threshold, a schema, a reference or a count is checked as code first.
requirement: Deterministic checks must be performed by code first, with models given only closed choices.

quote: No imports, no runtime calls, no shared files and no test fixtures from it.
requirement: The Librarian must take no dependency on the retiring MARK XLVIII harness.
note: A repository-boundary constraint, not a process; deferred in the README.

quote: A folder ingestion runs as a pipeline with tier 0 taking no more than its hand-over and hand-back (2 tier-0 turns).
requirement: Folder ingestion must run as a pipeline with at most two tier-0 turns.
pack_quote: Tier 0 commissions once and receives one handover: two tier-0 turns on the main path (ideal).
note: The two-turn target is carried as a handled weakness and performance target, but the performance table calls it a model figure until a run shows it.

quote: A synthesis per brief, so a multi-question brief gives each report its own "Together" and "Unknowns".
requirement: Each brief must have its own synthesis rather than one session-wide synthesis.
pack_quote: synth [activity; Lead (tier 1)]: records one synthesis per brief
note: Carried in research:synth and handled against W-RES-03.

quote: Research rounds stop surfacing folder cards and the library's own design notes as candidates for an outside-corpus brief.
requirement: Research candidates for an outside-corpus brief must come from the named corpus only.
pack_quote: candidates [activity; Core]: adds finds from the corpus only, read but unaccepted sources included and labelled
